scope: New reconstruction and exact verification; not recovery or replay of historical CM05 certificates. No root-count or root-localization search occurs here.

number_field.basis_index: bit mask product of sqrt(radicands); indices 0..7

A.threshold_proof: Integer base gaps <=2 have actual gap <9/4<5/2; base gaps >=3 have actual gap >11/4>5/2.

B.threshold_proof: Integer base gaps <=2 have actual gap <9/4<5/2; base gaps >=3 have actual gap >11/4>5/2.

pair_group_construction.coefficient: 2*Re(conj(z_i)*z_j), positive for A and negative for B
pair_group_construction.absolute_coefficient_mass_proof: Triangle inequality and |2 Re(conj(z_i) z_j)|<=2 over 3906 signed unordered contributions.

origin.remainder_proof: For x>=0 the third derivative magnitude of exp(-r*x) is <=r^3<8, so |D(x)-K2*x^2|<=7812*8*x^3/6=10416*x^3.
origin.conclusion: D(x)>x^2/64 for 0<x<=2^-24; origin has multiplicity exactly two.
